sloka: मृदिताश्चापविद्धाश्च दृश्यन्ते कमलस्रज: ।कामिभिर्वनिते पश्य फलानि विविधानि च ॥ २.९४.२५॥
transliteration: mṛditāścāpaviddhāśca dṛśyante kamalasraja: ।kāmibhirvanite paśya phalāni vividhāni ca ॥ 2.94.25॥

translations.english: O Lady, behold those lotus garlands crushed and cast aside by lovers and also many fruits (tasted by them and) lying there.
